scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @kynorix/api && npm run build -w @kynorix/worker && npm run build -w @kynorix/web && npm run build -w @kynorix/admin && npm run build -w @kynorix/mobile
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @kynorix/contracts && npm run build -w @kynorix/core && npm run build -w @kynorix/database
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web,admin -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @kynorix/api" "npm run dev -w @kynorix/worker" "npm run dev -w @kynorix/web" "npm run dev -w @kynorix/admin"
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run forbidden-terms:check && npm run db:migrations:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
